products.name: Oracle C2M DevOps Release Management & CI/CD Automation — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish DevOps release management and CI/CD for C2M — a build/promote/deploy pipeline plus routine-task automation — so releases are repeatable, governed, and fast, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Automate C2M releases — repeatable, governed, hands-off

Manual C2M releases are slow and error-prone. This solution establishes DevOps release management and CI/CD for Oracle C2M: a pipeline for building, promoting, and deploying OUAF config and code across environments, with automation for the routine admin tasks — so releases are repeatable, governed, and fast, pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M DevOps model: source control for OUAF config/code, a build/promote/deploy pipeline, and automation of routine admin.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (CI/CD tooling, source control, environment access, migration/CMA tooling).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to define the pipeline (build → migrate config → deploy → validate), wire automation for routine tasks (restarts, checks, promotions), add gates/rollback, and validate, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (pipeline runs, deploys succeed, rollback works) plus Best Practices for governed, automated releases.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M releases that are repeatable, governed, and fast — a CI/CD pipeline and routine-task automation — instead of slow, error-prone manual work.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MDEVOPS-Discovery.sh — read-only inventory of a C2M/OUAF environment and its release pipeline
    • OC2MDEVOPS-Remediation.sh — guided, DRY-RUN-by-default remediation of release-pipeline gaps
    • OC2MDEVOPS-Report.sql — read-only source-vs-target compare report for a promoted release scope
    • OC2MDEVOPS-ScopeHelper.sh — resolve and print a release's scope before it runs through the pipeline
    • OC2MDEVOPS-Validation.py — read-only WLST parity/health validation of a release-pipeline target

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
